# XLSX export library

SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, downloaded from the authoritative upstream CDN:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/xlsx.mjs

The included SheetJS-LICENSE.txt contains the upstream Apache 2.0 license.
The module is imported only when XLSX is selected; it adds no initial-page load.
